Though you mentioned as Moderate Risk, but 12 years investment horizon with high risk is almost equal to Moderate risk with 7 year investment horizon. Main point is, people say they are high risk taker but when Equity Mutual Funds drops 30%, they became panicky and redeem all. 3. Market cycle or economic cycle is of 6 to 6.5 years, where equity market reaches to one top value and then one bottom value. This cycle is typically a sinusoidal curve at around 30% angle to horizontal axis. (Refer Image at the bottom). 4. For 5–7 years, you may go for Equity Mutual Funds, but if you invest at top of market cycle and redeem at bottom of next market cycle, you may get very less return (but not negative return). If you invest at bottom of the market cycle (which may be right now probably) and redeem at top of the next market cycle then you may get good return (10-13%). For 5–7 years, you can choose Largecap fund, Nifty 50 Index Fund or Flexicap Fund. Largecap fund or Nifty 50 Index Fund is less volatile than Flexicap Fund (but will give 1.5 to 2% less returns than Flexicap funds). You can choose any after rethinking whether you are a really Moderate risk taker or Conservative investor. 5.
